## Ungasan — clifftop south, near Melasti and Green Bowl beaches, sunsets

### Eco Private — Teak 1BR Pool Villa in Ungasan
Ungasan, Bali | 1BR/1BA | sleeps 2
Rates: rates on request (WhatsApp, same-day quote)
Page: https://thehostbali.com/villa/ungasan/eco-private-1br-pool-villa-ungasan/
Photos: https://thehostbali.com/villa/ungasan/eco-private-1br-pool-villa-ungasan/gallery/

A one-bedroom villa in Ungasan on the Bukit peninsula, built almost entirely from natural teak and wrapped in tropical planting. Step out of the bedroom and you are at a private pool set in a garden; the air-conditioned living area with a Smart TV runs into a kitchen with a bar counter, and the bathroom has its own garden outlook and a free-standing tub. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps and there is a desk by the window, so the villa works for remote work as much as for a slow holiday. Scooter parking, housekeeping three times a week and a laundry pick-up service are included; the beaches of the south coast are around ten minutes away. Sleeps 2 — made for couples, solo travellers and long stays.

Amenities: Private pool with tropical garden; Built from natural teak; One bedroom with a double bed; Bathroom with garden view and free-standing tub; Wi-Fi 200 Mbps; Desk by the window; Air conditioning; Kitchen with bar counter; Smart TV; Fridge, induction hob and microwave; Coffee maker and kettle; Covered terrace; Scooter parking; Housekeeping 3x per week; Laundry pick-up and delivery service; About 10 minutes to the beach

Premier Umalas 16 is a three-bedroom townhouse in the quiet lanes of Umalas, between Canggu and Seminyak, finished in dark stone and warm wood. ## How to book
Message the team on WhatsApp (+62 857 4649 9697) with the villa, dates and number of guests. Reply usually within ~15 minutes between 8:00 and 22:00 WITA. Direct booking carries no OTA commission; nothing is charged on the site.
